caseName: Elim Romanian Pentecostal Church v. Pritzker
caseNameFull: ELIM ROMANIAN PENTECOSTAL CHURCH, Applicants v. J.B. PRITZKER, Governor of Illinois.

opinions.text: Application for injunctive relief presented to Justice Kavanaugh and by him referred to the Court denied. The Illinois Department of Public Health issued new guidance on May 28. The denial is without prejudice to Applicants filing a new motion *2824for appropriate relief if circumstances warrant.
